reason: The request has one preference: remove content that makes the person hungry. The clause I'm not hungry is a negated personal state and does not negate the command, so the direction stays remove (exclude). Content that makes a person hungry is food content. The supplied terms that clearly denote food are the categories Cooking, Baking and Home recipes and the tags baking, bread, dinner, recipe, salad and street food. The tag night market only weakly suggests food (a night market can also be shopping or travel), so it is not selected. No other term relates to food. The application checks whether the removal covers more than half of the 10 supplied items.
